sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move door back down chimney step by step, checking for completion
for i in range(3):
    r=action(['DOWN'])
    res=last_action_result
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    pos={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='O':
            b=n['boundary']; pos['O']=(min(p[0] for p in b),max(p[0] for p in b),min(p[1] for p in b),max(p[1] for p in b))
    print(f"DOWN {i+1}: done={res.get('done')} lvl={res.get('level_completed')} changed={res.get('board_changed')} O={pos.get('O')}")
    if res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over'):
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
